Gayatri Choudhury

Senior Software Engineer | Java & Microservices Expert | Spring Boot | Kafka | Distributed Systems

+91-7349764780  	gayatri.choudhury0787@gmail.com	

Core Competencies	Profile Summary

Enterprise Application Development

Performance Optimization & Tuning

In-memory Data Grids (Oracle Coherence)

Containerization & Deployment (Docker)

CI/CD Pipeline Implementation

Agile Project Execution & Sprint Management

Technical Mentorship & Code Reviews

Unit & Integration Test Automation

Backend System Integration & API Design

Metadata Processing & Entity Linking

Release Planning & Delivery Management

Version Control & Repository Management (Git, TFS)

Visionary Senior Software Engineer; offering 13.5 years of experience in full-stack enterprise application development, specializing in Java (8–17), Spring Boot, Microservices, and distributed system design across large-scale financial and legal-tech platforms.

Proven success in end-to-end product lifecycle ownership—from requirement analysis, architecture design, agile planning, to development, testing, and production deployment—working closely with global teams and stakeholders.

Demonstrated expertise in data engineering and messaging systems, including Kafka, JMS, and Oracle Coherence (in-memory caching), with a focus on building high- performance, fault-tolerant backend systems.

Played a strategic role in technical leadership, driving initiatives like code reviews, team mentoring, agile ceremonies, and release management while aligning product delivery with business outcomes.

Recognized with multiple awards and leadership accolades at Thomson Reuters for innovative contributions (e.g., Coherence Cache implementation), along with hands-on experience in CI/CD pipelines, Docker-based containerization, and cross-team collaboration for scalable system solutions.

Certifications & Trainings

Agile Methodologies

Amazon AWS (Fundamentals) Presentation & Communication Skills

Career Timeline

Technical Skills

Languages & Frameworks: Java (8–17), Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Security, JPA

Architecture & Methodologies: Microservices, Distributed Systems, Agile/ Scrum,

2012-2021

Work Experience

Since 2021

Orchestrator Design Pattern Data & Messaging: Kafka, JMS, Oracle Coherence, Oracle 11g DevOps & Tools: Docker, Jenkins, Gradle, Maven, Git, TFS, IntelliJ, Eclipse, JIRA Testing & QA: JUnit, Mockito Other Skills: Multithreading, Concurrency, REST APIs, XML, RegEx

 Since Nov 2021 | Senior Software Engineer | IRIS Software | Bangalore, India 

Client: Citi Bank

Project: Strategic Financial Resource Management (SFRM)

Microservices-based forecasting platform for Citi Bank, enabling revenue projections across cards, retail, and banking. Built using orchestrator design pattern.

Key Result Areas:

Led analysis, design, and delivery of critical product features with full ownership from estimation to deployment.

Directed release planning and sprint execution, ensuring timely delivery in Agile environment.

Provided peer code reviews, unit testing, and technical mentorship. Facilitated client engagement throughout development lifecycle.

Environment: Java 17, Spring Boot, Microservices, Kafka, Docker, Jenkins, Oracle 11g

Awards

Hall of Fame Award – Oracle	Coherence Implementation

Employee of the Month (Multiple Occasions) – Thomson Reuters

Bronze & Silver Awards – New project contributions & excellence in delivery

Education

Master of Computer Application (MCA) | GIET, Gunupur, BPUT University, Odisha, India | 2010

Soft Skills

Change Catalyst Attention to Detail Thought Leader Critical Thinker

 Jan 2012 – Oct 2021 | Senior Developer | Thomson Reuters | Bangalore, India 

Key Projects:

Westlaw CANADA / UK / US – Thomson Reuters

Delivered high-performance backend systems for legislative referencing across Canada, UK, and US jurisdictions using advanced NLP (StandFord Core NLP), RegEx & entity-linking logic.

	Played a strategic role in redesigning Bermuda Engine dependencies, enabling real- time linking for Acts, Caselaw, and Tribunal references.

	Directed TFS-to-Git migration for version control modernization and led multi-country development coordination.

	Environment: Java, NLP, REST APIs, Gradle, Oracle 11g, Git, Linux, Spring MVC

Oracle Coherence Cache – Bermuda Platform

In-memory data grid system to host legal publishing metadata (LPA, Topic & Key), designed for high scalability and fault tolerance using multicast communication.

	Implemented Oracle Coherence for distributed caching with focus on performance and node availability.

	Optimized communication between clustered nodes using multicast addressing for fault tolerance.

	Environment: Java, Oracle Coherence, Gradle.

Entity Linking Engine (EIRW-TMS) – Westlaw US

Backend engine to intelligently link judges, attorneys, arbitrators, and patent examiners in legal content.

	Designed and deployed custom parsing engines using RegEx, Spring MVC, and JMS.

	Introduced performance monitoring features and integrated unit testing into CI workflow.

	Environment: Java, RegEx, Spring MVC, JMS, Oracle 11g.

XML Metadata Transformation Tool

Automated XML restructuring and metadata enrichment to support existing parsing services.

	Designed filters and transformation logic for dynamic entity recognition. 	Ensured compliance with pre-existing schema for seamless integration. 	Environment: Java, XML, REST, Oracle 11g

Cite Doctor – Westlaw US

Manual tagging and correction tool for legal document citations not auto-linked by backend engines.

	Developed filters and tagging logic using Java and RegEx.

	Collaborated directly with US teams for ongoing feature enhancements and system stabilization.

	Environment: Java, Spring, REST

Personal Details

Languages Known: English, Hindi, Odia & Kannada

Address: Flat No. B202, DSR Sunshine Apartment, Banaswadi, Bangalore – 560079
